# Ravensbank Bridge Company - barrier journal

The barrier at the bridge registers every vehicle that crosses and writes a line
to logs/bridge-crossings.log:

    <recorded UTC time> CROSSED at=<UTC time> class=<car|van|hgv> weight=<kg>

`at` is when the barrier registered the crossing and `weight` is the weight the
plate under the road read as the vehicle passed; the first stamp is when the
record reached the office, which is later, because the barrier holds its records
while the link to the office is down and sends them in batches once the link is
back. `class` is the class the axle sensor put the vehicle in. The journal
covers one day and is closed with a line counting every record above it.

turns.prompt: Ravensbank Bridge Company's barrier registers each vehicle that crosses the bridge and sends its records to the office when the link is up. The resurfacing record for 6 September 2026 needs the traffic that crossed between 06:00 and 09:00 that morning. How many vehicles crossed the bridge in those hours? Give the count alone, as digits, with no label. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
